title: Full-width map and paper ultimate effects
problem: The owner asked: the map should fill the screen's width (on many phones it showed narrow with empty sides), and the ultimate effects should be redrawn in the paper style.
scope: The map fills the screen width (DEC-019): the field takes the full column; the usual view fits the map's width and starts at your side; drag up and down; the corner button shows the whole map and comes back; double-tap and pinch zoom closer; tapping a hero's panel scrolls to an off-screen hero
The map is painted once at the full-width scale; the paper board edge frames only the map

Ultimate effects redrawn in cut paper: paper strips and pieces with white cut edges and crisp shadows, tissue-paper glows, paper confetti, a paper crescent for Senja, a batik-dotted dome for Benteng, a paper wave for Ombak; the banner as a team-coloured paper card
Five suggestions to make the map more engaging (DEC-020, for the owner to choose)
Help text, owner checklist, art-style guide, phone check updated
exclusions: Changing the map's size or shape in the game rules
Building any of the five map ideas (waiting for the owner's choice)

acceptance.text: The map fills the screen width; drag looks around; the corner button shows the whole map and comes back; double-tap and pinch zoom (phone check)
acceptance.evidence: Phone check: the map fills the screen width (390 px; the whole map was 260 px on this screen); dragging looks up and down; the corner button shows the whole map and comes back; double-tap zooms in 1.8x and back; pinch zooms; orders work while zoomed; PHONE CHECK OK.

acceptance.text: Every ultimate effect and the banner drawn in cut paper (effect sheet of all 20 reviewed)
acceptance.evidence: Effect sheet of all 20 ultimate bursts, the five auras and both banners reviewed: paper strips and pieces with white cut edges and crisp shadows, tissue-paper glows, paper confetti, a clean crescent for Senja; screenshots of Kail's Riptide in a match checked.

acceptance.text: Speed: paper effects cost about the same as before per frame; the map still paints once (measured)
acceptance.evidence: Paper effects: about 1.07 ms per effect against 0.99 ms before (timing forced to finish). The map still paints once, in 11-18 ms. A full frame now takes about 4.3 ms (median) against about 3 ms before, because the map covers 50% more of the screen; 90th percentile about 14 ms after caching the fog layer. Desktop test browser without a graphics card, not a real phone.

acceptance.text: Game unchanged: verify, determinism, soak and phone check pass; no change in src/game
acceptance.evidence: npm run verify: 93/93 tests, build, docs and records; npm run soak 3/3; phone check OK; no change in src/game.
Not yet tried on the owner's phone.

risks: The far side of the map is off-screen in the usual view; the tower strip in the top bar and the whole-map button cover it, and a mini-map may be needed later
Paper effects draw every frame; measured to cost about the same as before

added: Whole-map view on the corner button; scroll to a hero when its panel is tapped
changed: The map fills the screen width and scrolls (DEC-019)
Ultimate effects and banners in cut paper
Fog of war's dyed layer cached (one pass a frame)
Board edge shadow crisp instead of blurred

userNotes: The map now fills the screen's width; drag up and down to look around, and tap the magnifier to see the whole map.
Ultimate effects and banners redrawn in cut paper.

approval.evidence: lets expand the map now so it fits the width of the screen ... redraw the ultimate effects in paper style too
